paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a,
heading: Aginom Lou Jerusalem
english: Again Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Jerusalem akihhuainate theikhesak inla, akiang ah,
english: “Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations;

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in Jerusalem kiang ah hichi in achi: Na pawtna gam leh na pianna gam Kanaan mite gam ahi a, na pa Amor mi ahi a, na nu Hit mi ahi.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says to Jerusalem: “Your origin and your birth is of the land of the Canaanite. An Amorite was your father, and your mother was a Hittite.

paite: Huan na pianna thu bel na pian ni in na laigui at ahi kei a, nang hihsiang ding a tui a sil na hi sam kei, chi nuh na tuak kei a, tuamlum na hi kei.
english: As for your birth, in the day you were born your navel was not cut. You weren’t washed in water to cleanse you. You weren’t salted at all, nor wrapped in blankets at all.

paite: Lainat ding a na tung a hiaite hih ding in kuamah mit in nang ahon hehpih kei ua; gamlak a paihkhiak na hita, na pian ni a kipan kih a om na hi hi."
english: No eye pitied you, to do any of these things to you, to have compassion on you; but you were cast out in the open field, because you were abhorred in the day that you were born.

paite: Huan na kiang a ka hong pai in sisan lak a kital in ka hon mu a, na kiang ah, "Sisan ah om lechin leng 'hing in!' ka hon chi a," ahi, ka hon chi ahi, "Sisan ah om mah lechin 'hing in!'
english: “‘“When I passed by you, and saw you wallowing in your blood, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’ Yes, I said to you, ‘Though you are in your blood, live!’

paite: Gam thil pakmum bang in ka hon khangsak a, khanglian a piching in, na hong melhoih mahmah hi. Na nawite ahong kisa ua, na sam ahong hoih a; himahleh savuak leh vuaktang lel na hi lailai hi."
english: I caused you to multiply as that which grows in the field, and you increased and grew great, and you attained to excellent beauty. Your breasts were formed, and your hair grew; yet you were naked and bare.

paite: Huan na kiang a ka hong pai a ka hon et in, deihhuai tham na hong hita a, ka puan ka hon zawn a, na vuaktanna ka hon khuhta hi; ahi, na kiang ah ka kichiam a, thukhun ah ka hon lutpih a, kei a na hita hi, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘“Now when I passed by you, and looked at you, behold, your time was the time of love; and I spread my garment over you and covered your nakedness. Yes, I pledged myself to you and entered into a covenant with you,” says the Lord Yahweh, “and you became mine.

paite: Huchi in tui in ka hon sil a, ahi, na sisan ka hon hihsiang sipsip a, sathau ka hon nuh hi.
english: “‘“Then I washed you with water. Yes, I thoroughly washed away your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil.

paite: Puanzem in ka hon van a, saham vun khedap ka hon bunsak a, puanmalngat hoih in ka hon van a, silk puan ka hon khusak hi.
english: I clothed you also with embroidered work and put leather sandals on you. I dressed you with fine linen and covered you with silk.

paite: Kizepna hoih in ka hon zem a, na khut ah taute, na ngawng ah dangka-eng khainiangte.
english: I decked you with ornaments, put bracelets on your hands, and put a chain on your neck.

paite: Na nak ah nakbulhte, na bil ah bilbahte, na lu ah lallukhu hoihtak in ka hon zem hi.
english: I put a ring on your nose, earrings in your ears, and a beautiful crown on your head.

paite: Huchi in dangka-eng leh dangkasik a zephoih na hita a, na puansilhte puanmalngat hoihtak leh silk puan leh puankhui kilawm ahi ua; na nek tangbuang nel leh khuaizu leh sathau ahi, na kilawm mahmah a, kumpi chi leng na ching hi.
english: Thus you were decked with gold and silver. Your clothing was of fine linen, silk, and embroidered work. You ate fine flour, honey, and oil. You were exceedingly beautiful, and you prospered to royal estate.

paite: Na kilawmna ziak in namte lak ah athangkhia a, ka thupina a kivan in na buchingta, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: Your renown went out among the nations for your beauty; for it was perfect, through my majesty which I had put on you,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Himahleh na kilawmna na muang lua a, na minthanna na hukloh a, mi vialvak peuh leh na muh peuh na kithuahpih hi.
english: “‘“But you trusted in your beauty, and played the prostitute because of your renown, and poured out your prostitution on everyone who passed by. It was his.

paite: Na puansilhte suah in mun sangte na zuan a, huai ah kizuak in na pang a, hichibang in na om ngei nawn kei ding hi.
english: You took some of your garments, and made for yourselves high places decked with various colors, and played the prostitute on them. This shouldn’t happen, neither shall it be.

paite: Ka dangka-eng leh ka dangkasik tui-um belsuan hoih taktak ka hon piakte na la a, pasal limbawlna ding in na zang, na hukpihta hi.
english: You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of men, and played the prostitute with them.

paite: Puansilh khui kilawmte na la a, amau na tuam a, ka sathaute leh ka gimlimte ama uah na tung hi.
english: You took your embroidered garments, covered them, and set my oil and my incense before them.

paite: Ka hon tanghou piak leng ka tangbuang hoih leh sathau leh khuaizu ka hon vaknate gimlim ding in ama uah na lui a; hichi ahong hita, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: My bread also which I gave you, fine flour, oil, and honey, with which I fed you, you even set it before them for a pleasant aroma; and so it was,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: Huai lou leng na tanu, na tapa, na hon suansakte akiang uah kithoihna ding in zatbei ding in na pia a; na hukna thil namai ahi a hia?
english: “‘“Moreover you have taken your sons and your daughters, whom you have borne to me, and you have sacrificed these to them to be devoured. Was your prostitution a small matter,

paite: Ka tate na thah a, meipi a pailut a akiang ua na latte?
english: that you have slain my children and delivered them up, in causing them to pass through the fire to them?

paite: Na kihhuaina leh na hukna tengteng ah na naupan lai avuaktang a na omleh na sisan a na tal maimah hunlaite na thei nawnta kei hi.
english: In all your abominations and your prostitution you have not remembered the days of your youth, when you were naked and bare, and were wallowing in your blood.

paite: Huan hiai na thulimlouhna tengteng khit in leng, hichi ahong hi a, na tung agik hi! Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
heading: Kizuak Bang A Jerusalem Hinkhua
english: “‘“It has happened after all your wickedness—woe, woe to you!” says the Lord Yahweh—

paite: Mun kiphoute na kibawlna, kongzing chiteng ah mun sangte na lam hi.
english: “that you have built for yourselves a vaulted place, and have made yourselves a lofty place in every street.

paite: Lampi kipatna teng ah mun sang na lam a, na kilawmna kihhuai in na bawl a vialvak peuhmahte kiang ah na kilemdawk a, na hukna a-uang semsem hi.
english: You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened your feet to everyone who passed by, and multiplied your prostitution.

paite: Aigupta mi, na inveng, sami mahmah toh kingaihna khelhna leng na hihta; hon hehsak ding in na hukna na uangsakta ahi.
english: You have also committed sexual immorality with the Egyptians, your neighbors, great of flesh; and have multiplied your prostitution, to provoke me to anger.

paite: Huaiziak in ngai in, na tung ah ka khut ka lik a, na an nek ka kiamsak a, nang hon mudah Philistia tanute, na hukdan zumpih mahmah nute kiang ah ut-ut a ahon bawl ding un ka hon peta hi.
english: See therefore, I have stretched out my hand over you, and have diminished your portion, and delivered you to the will of those who hate you, the daughters of the Philistines, who are ashamed of your lewd way.

paite: Assuria mite kiang ah leng na kizuak a, huntawk chih lah nei tel lou; ahi, akiang uah kizuak in na pang a, na kham tuan sam kei hi.
english: You have played the prostitute also with the Assyrians, because you were insatiable; yes, you have played the prostitute with them, and yet you weren’t satisfied.

paite: Kanaan gam ah, Kaldai mite kiang ah na hukna na uangsak lailai a, na kham tuan kei hi.
english: You have moreover multiplied your prostitution to the land of merchants, to Chaldea; and yet you weren’t satisfied with this.

paite: Nang lungtang sia hina mai e, na tatdan numei genhak gilou mahmah mai thil na hih a, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: “‘“How weak is your heart,” says the Lord Yahweh, “since you do all these things, the work of an impudent prostitute;

paite: Lamka thuam teng a milim biakna inn na bawl a, kongzing chih a mun sang na bawlte loh na delh louh ziak in kizuak leng na bang kei hi.
english: in that you build your vaulted place at the head of every way, and make your lofty place in every street, and have not been as a prostitute, in that you scorn pay.

paite: Zi angkawm, pasalte sang a mi tuam deihzaw nu!
english: “‘“Adulterous wife, who takes strangers instead of her husband!

paite: Kizuakte kiang ah thil apesek ua, nang bel na lehpiak a hon deihmi ang ah, gam chih a kipan ahong pai ua, ahon kithuahpih theihna ding un na nou zaw nak ahi.
english: People give gifts to all prostitutes; but you give your gifts to all your lovers, and bribe them, that they may come to you on every side for your prostitution.

paite: Huan na huk thu a kuamah in ahon zot louh midang toh na kibatlouhna uh ahi; nang aman na pe zosop a; kuamah in man ahon piak louh uh na lamdanna ahi.
english: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.”’

paite: Huaiziak in aw mihuknu, TOUPA thu ngai in;
heading: Jerusalem Tung A Pathian Thukhenna
english: “Therefore, prostitute, hear Yahweh’s word:

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: Na kihhuaina buakkhiak ahih a, na mingaihte toh na kithuahna lam ua na vuaktanna suklat ahih ziak leh na kihhuaina milim tengteng ziak leh akiang ua na piak na tate sisan ziak in;
english: ‘The Lord Yahweh says, “Because your filthiness was poured out, and your nakedness uncovered through your prostitution with your lovers; and because of all the idols of your abominations, and for the blood of your children, that you gave to them;

paite: ngai in, nang hon ngaimi na nuamtatpihte tengteng leh na na ngaih khitsa tengteng leh na muhdahte tengteng ka samkhawm ding a, ahi, na kim ah ka pikhawm ding a, na vuaktanna tengteng amuhtheihna ding un akiang uah na vuaktanna ka hihlang ding hi.
english: therefore see, I will gather all your lovers, with whom you have taken pleasure, and all those whom you have loved, with all those whom you have hated. I will even gather them against you on every side, and will uncover your nakedness to them, that they may see all your nakedness.

paite: Huan numei pasal khen a, amah ta sisan suah tungthu a bang in ka hon vaihawmkhum ding; hehna leh mullitna sisan na tung ah ka tungsak ding.
english: I will judge you as women who break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring on you the blood of wrath and jealousy.

paite: Akhut uah ka hon pe dia, na mun kidohte ahihpuk ding ua, na mun sangte achimsak ding ua; na puansilhte asuah ding ua, na suangmantamte ahon sut ding ua, savuak leh vuaktang in ahon nuse ding uh.
english: I will also give you into their hand, and they will throw down your vaulted place, and break down your lofty places. They will strip you of your clothes and take your beautiful jewels. They will leave you naked and bare.

paite: Na tung ah mipi akaikhawm ding ua, suang in ahon deng ding ua, namsau in ahon kui pailet ding uhi.
english: They will also bring up a company against you, and they will stone you with stones, and thrust you through with their swords.

paite: Na innte mei in ahal ding ua, numei tampi mitmuh in na tung ah vaihawmna atangtungsak ding ua; na hukna ka tawpsak ding a, loh leng na peta kei ding hi.
english: They will burn your houses with fire, and execute judgments on you in the sight of many women. I will cause you to cease from playing the prostitute, and you will also give no hire any more.

paite: Huchi in ka hehna na tung ah ka lungdamsak ding a, ka hon mullitna adaita ding, ka dai dide dia, ka heh ngei nawn kei ding hi.
english: So I will cause my wrath toward you to rest, and my jealousy will depart from you. I will be quiet, and will not be angry any more.

paite: Na tuailai nite na theihgige louh a, hiai thilte a na hon vuisak zawk ziak in, ngai in, na tatdan dan, na tung ah ka tun ding, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi. Huan na kihhuaina tengteng behlap in hiai hukna na hih nawn kei ding hi.
english: “‘“Because you have not remembered the days of your youth, but have raged against me in all these things; therefore, behold, I also will bring your way on your head,” says the Lord Yahweh: “and you shall not commit this lewdness with all your abominations.

paite: "Ngai in, paunak zang peuhmah in hiai paunak azang ding uh, 'Atanu in anu asuun,' chih.
heading: Tanu In Anu Asuun
english: “‘“Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use this proverb against you, saying, ‘As is the mother, so is her daughter.’

paite: Na nu, amah pasal leh tate mudahnu tanu na hi a, kitanauna lam ah bel, ama pasal leh tate mudahnu tanau na hi; na nu Hit mi ahi a, na pa Amor mi ahi.
english: You are the daughter of your mother, who loathes her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children. Your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

paite: "Huan na tanau, na u Samaria, na veilam a teng amah leh atanute toh ahi uh; na tanau, na nau, na taklam a teng Sodom leh atanute ahi uhi.
english: Your elder sister is Samaria, who dwells at your left hand, she and her daughters; and your younger sister, who dwells at your right hand, is Sodom with her daughters.

paite: Himahleh amau omdan na zui kei a, akihhuaina bang uh na hih kei na a, na omdan tengteng a na thulim louh zawkdan ngaihtuah in huaite bangmah tham ahi kei hi.
english: Yet you have not walked in their ways, nor done their abominations; but soon you were more corrupt than they in all your ways.

paite: "Kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi, nang leh na tate'n ahih bang uh na tanau Sodom leh atanute'n leng ahih het kei uh.
english: As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “Sodom your sister has not done, she nor her daughters, as you have done, you and your daughters.

paite: Na tanau Sodom thulimlouhna hiaite ahi: kisaktheihna, nekvah luatnate, amah leh atanute nuamtat mawkmawkte, migentheite leh tasamte apanpih tuan sam kei uh.
english: “‘“Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

paite: Huan mi uang ahi ua, ka ma a thilkihhuai hihsa ahi uh; huchi in hoih ka sak bang in ka hihmangta ahi.
english: They were arrogant and committed abomination before me. Therefore I took them away when I saw it.

paite: "Samaria in na khelhna kimkhat leng ahih sam kei; amau sang a na kihhuainate na nak hih zawk ziak in na hihsa na kihhuaina tengteng in na sanggamnute siam na tangsak hi.
english: Samaria hasn’t committed half of your sins; but you have multiplied your abominations more than they, and have justified your sisters by all your abominations which you have done.

paite: Na sanggamnute dikzaw a na suklat ziak in nangmah in na zahlakna na puak ding ahi; amau sang in thilkihhuai uangzawte na hih a, na khelhnate ziak in amau nang sang in adiktatzaw uhi; ahi, na sanggamnute siam na tansakna ah nang anen-aham in zahlakna na tang ding ahi.
english: You also bear your own shame yourself, in that you have given judgment for your sisters; through your sins that you have committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than you. Yes, be also confounded, and bear your shame, in that you have justified your sisters.

paite: "Huan a-omdan uh, Sodom leh atanu omdante, Samaria leh atanu omdante, amaute toh ton in nang omdan mahmah ka hei ding.
heading: Sodom Leh Samaria Tunding Nawn Ahi Ding Uh
english: “‘“I will reverse their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of your captives among them;

paite: Amau a dia lungmuanna na na hih sekna a na thilhihsa tengteng ziak a na zumtheihna ding in.
english: that you may bear your own shame, and may be ashamed because of all that you have done, in that you are a comfort to them.

paite: Huan na sanggamnute, Sodom leh atanute, Samaria leh atanute a-omdan uh masa bang in a-om nawn ding ua; nang leh na tanu leng na omdan uh masa bang in na om nawn ding uh.
english: Your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will return to their former estate; and Samaria and her daughters will return to their former estate; and you and your daughters will return to your former estate.

paite: Na thulimlouhna muhkhiak a hih ma a na kihih thupi nite in na sanggamnu Sodom na kamse khuahna ahi sek kei maw?
english: For your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the day of your pride,

paite: Tu'n zaw Siria tanu leh akim a mi tengteng, Philistia tanute na kim a hon simmoh mite'n ahon genseta uhi.
english: before your wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all who are around her, the daughters of the Philistines, who despise you all around.

paite: Na hukna leh na kihhuaina na po zel ahi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: You have borne your lewdness and your abominations,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huchi in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Thukhun bohsia in thuchiam na khawksak louhdan bang zel in na tung ah ka hih tei sin ahi.
heading: Tangtawn Daih Thukhun
english: “‘For the Lord Yahweh says: “I will also deal with you as you have done, who have despised the oath in breaking the covenant.

paite: Himahleh na naupan lai a na kiang a ka thukhun ka theigige ding a, na kiang ah tangtawn thukhun ka bawl ding hi.
english: Nevertheless I will remember my covenant with you in the days of your youth, and I will establish an everlasting covenant with you.

paite: Huchi in na sanggamnute ka pom hun chiang in na omdante na hon theikhe ding a, na kizumpih ding; amau lah na tanu ding in ka hon pia hi, na thukhun ziak bel hilou in.
english: Then you will remember your ways and be ashamed when you receive your sisters, your elder sisters and your younger; and I will give them to you for daughters, but not by your covenant.

paite: Na kiang a ka thukhun ka hihkip ding a, TOUPA ka hi chih na theita ding uh.
english: I will establish my covenant with you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh;

paite: Na thilhih tengteng ka hon ngaihdam vek hun chiang in na theihgigena na zum ziak a na kam kat nawnlouhna ding in," chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
english: that you may remember, and be confounded, and never open your mouth any more because of your shame, when I have forgiven you all that you have done,” says the Lord Yahweh.’”
